root_cause: The mistake in using the equality operator (`==`) instead of the assignment operator (`=`) prevents `exist[j]` from being updated correctly when a matching "o" is found in the grid.
suggestion:
Suggestion 1. Replace `==` with `=` in the if condition Locate the line:
```java
if grid[i][j] == "o":
  exist[j] == True
```
Replace it with:
```java
if grid[i][j] == "o":
  exist[j] = True
```
This will ensure that `exist[j]` is correctly set to `True` when the condition `grid[i][j] == "o"` is met.
